question: Can stronger PF motion roughening materially reduce IDSW toward EKF without degrading HOTA?
context: R72 0.5/1.0/2.0 showed decreasing UA IDSW as motion roughening rose; R75 recentering did not transfer to BDD.
baseline: PF500-K1K2 motion roughening 2.0, no recentering, seed 0/1/2
implementation: New opt-in pf_allow_high_motion_roughening permits values up to 4.0; old validation and default remain unchanged.
development: UA-DETRAC train dev12, R72 YOLOv8n COCO c25 cache/GT, 25 fps, elapsed skip
confirmation: BDDCOCOVID-val 200 videos, R61 YOLOv8n COCO c25 cache/GT, 5 fps, elapsed steps, mot_crowd
stages: unit validation and historical default regression
UA smoke 2 videos for both candidates x 3 seeds
UA full dev12 for both candidates x 3 seeds
BDD three-video smoke and full 200-video x 3 seeds for one candidate only if UA IDSW improves at least 10 percent vs motion2 and HOTA falls no more than 0.5 percentage points
selection: Among UA-gate-eligible candidates, choose lower mean IDSW; tie within 10 switches chooses higher HOTA. If neither passes, stop without BDD full.
interpretation: This is parameter search on observed development data; report all attempted levels, paired seed/video statistics, HOTA/DetA/IDF1 and do not change thesis defaults or claim blind generalization.
